numeric_confirmation.choice: First default-self-coupling candidate with observations on all three inner replicates and lower arithmetic mean than the identical-rate EMPF control. Freeze before scoring the candidate on Screen1_0.

freeze.primary: mean paired four-target Screen1_0 energy difference (v11 minus EMPF) over all 12 seeds; report uncertainty and each seed; no early stopping or score-driven candidate replacement

freeze.selection: Two public transport settings with first-moment beta 0.9 reduced three-fold validation energy to 0.9261 vs 0.9425 at identical rates and beta. Freeze before scoring any of these eight training seeds. Compare to the exact matched EMPF and independently selected EMPF as well as the historical 0.10.0 control.

Same frozen momentum candidate and all three EMPF controls, using deterministic PyTorch kernels and seeded global streams for both releases. Freeze four additional seeds before scoring them, to check sensitivity to the default CUDA kernel variation seen in duplicate EMPF validation fits.

Choose the native hollow self plan plus active critic weight by the lowest mean energy across the three deterministic training-side folds. Then test the single selected candidate on every seed from 32 through 39 against matched 0.11.1 EMPF and the original historical 0.10.0 EMPF. No early stopping; lower paired mean is the win criterion. All three arms use deterministic CUDA, the original network and unmodified release binaries.

optimizer_interpretation.unified_v11: UnifiedV11EquilibratedOptimizer reads betas for generator, particle, and critic groups.
optimizer_interpretation.empf: Both tested releases use DirectionBlendOptimizer for G/prior and NormalizedOptimizer for D, with native optimizer_momentum 0.0. betas[0] does not change these DualNorm updates. The direction_blend recipe rejects nonzero optimizer_momentum. Same-wheel mid vs control-b9-mid are repeated EMPF arms. Original protocol text is preserved; the interpretation here supersedes its nominal momentum labels.

protocol.control: Deterministic native EMPF mid from hollow-confirm inner on the same physical cards. Default released v11 self-coupling, no optimizer momentum. After observing that a single upper-neighbour quantile reduces the neutral-critic radial bias (2.52 to 1.04), measure that scalar alone and with two units of active critic weight.

protocol.rule: Reg 3 and 10 improved active-pair validation before the self-plan adjustment. Test that single additional coefficient in both recipes. Select each formulation independently using three training folds at seed 0. Replay both winners and both default-coefficient controls on all three folds at training seed 1. Only advance a changed candidate to another outer cohort if its six-score mean beats independently selected EMPF as well as its original coefficient. No outer scores in the selection criterion.

freeze.selection: Cross both pre-existing rate settings with the same frozen zero-momentum v11 configuration and with EMPF in both release wheels. The primary comparison uses the historical EMPF rates for all three formulations/releases. The second comparison uses the v11 preset rates for all three. Compare mean paired target energy over all eight new training seeds. Report all six arms; avoid selection on outer seeds.

validation_momentum_grid_protocol.criterion: Check whether the improvement at first moment 0.9 persists across nearby values. Finish all three validation replicates for both formulations. Compare their equally tuned best aggregate and the frozen v11 0.9 reference, without using any outer scores for selection.
